_comment: This file is intentionally NOT the real one: settings.local.json accumulates
absolute paths and one-off allow entries and must never be committed.
The two env vars below only matter when the commit gate cannot resolve a
toolchain from PATH. .claude/hooks/verify-gate.sh fails OPEN in that case —
it prints one stderr notice and lets the commit through — so a machine that
needs these and does not set them has no gate at all. Check for the notice.
Prefer broad permission patterns over the literal command Claude Code
proposes: an entry like Bash(sed -n '419,420p' app/lib/main.dart) will never
match again and is pure noise.
